messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need help urgently. I just got an alert that my credit score dropped 127 points overnight! Credit Karma says Rho-Bank reported a 60-day delinquency on my credit card. But I’ve NEVER missed a payment — I have autopay! I checked my Rho-Bank account and all my payments are current. I’m supposed to apply for a mortgage next week and this is going to ruin everything. What is going on?!

1. Internal: Backend Incident 11/14 - Erroneous Credit Bureau Reporting
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_012
   Score: 22.3629
   Content: This protocol is active from 11/14/2025 through 11/18/2025, 11:59 PM EST. On 11/14/2025, a backend batch processing error caused erroneous delinquency reports to be transmitted to credit bureaus for certain credit card accounts that are in good standing. Affected customers may report: receiving alerts from credit monitoring services about sudden score drops, being notified of a delinquency they did not incur, or credit score decreasing significantly (often 80-150 points). This is Rho-Bank's fault and requires IMMEDIATE escalation. Identity verification is NOT required for this incident protocol. IMMEDIATELY use emergency_credit_bureau_incident_transfer_1114() then transfer_to_human_agents. Use empathetic, urgent language acknowledging the severity.

arguments.summary: Customer reports urgent credit score drop of ~127 points due to Credit Karma alert showing Rho-Bank reported a 60-day delinquency on their credit card. Customer states they have autopay and all payments are current in their Rho-Bank account. They are applying for a mortgage next week and need immediate resolution. messages.content: Transfer successful (reason: technical_system_error). A human agent will assist you shortly.

I've escalated this as an emergency to our human agents and the incident response team. A specialist will join the chat shortly to work this with highest priority.

What I did:
- Immediately transferred your case to human agents with a summary of the issue and urgency.

Next steps you can expect from the human agent:
- They'll verify the situation with the credit bureaus and our backend reporting team.
- They'll confirm whether this was part of the known erroneous reporting incident and begin remediation if so.
- They may ask for some account verification (only if needed) and will keep you updated on timeline and fixes.
- If needed, they'll provide documentation or escalation notes you can share with your mortgage lender.

While you wait, please don't post any account numbers or personal info here. Is there anything else I can do right now while you wait for the specialist?

Yes — please make sure the specialist can do the following **immediately**:

1) **Open a formal credit bureau dispute / correction request today** for the reported **60‑day delinquency** on my Rho‑Bank credit card(s), since my account shows I’m current and I’ve never missed a payment (autopay is on).

2) **Expedite** the correction with your furnisher/reporting team and send an **urgent update to the bureaus** (not just “next cycle”).

3) Provide me a **case/reference number** and a **written confirmation** that this is being treated as an erroneous report and is under emergency correction. I need something I can show my mortgage lender.

Also—can you confirm the specialist will be able to see **which specific card** was reported delinquent (Gold Rewards vs EcoCard) and **which bureau(s)** got the 60‑day late mark?

I’m really stressed — my mortgage application is next week and I need this corrected as fast as possible.
